case_title: INDIANA D. VEGA BLANDINO VS. WESTERN DENTAL SERVICES, INC.

docket_entries.description: STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE PRO TEM JUDGE.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-02-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BLANDINO, INDIANA D. VEGA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT WESTERN DENTAL SERVICES, INC. $4,900.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,900.00, DEFENDANT FAILED TO PROPERLY TREAT PLAINTIFF IN ATTEMPTING TO PROVIDE HER WITH PROPERLY FITTING PARTIAL DENTURE DEVICES. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,900.00 FILED BY BLANDINO, INDIANA D. VEGA AS TO DEFENDANT WESTERN DENTAL SERVICES, INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-06-2019 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

REQUEST TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF BLANDINO, INDIANA D. VEGA ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED JUN-17-2019, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT WESTERN DENTAL SERVICES, INC.
ORDER RE: CONTINUED FOR SPANISH INTERPRETER FOR DISCOVERY. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-06-2019 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF TO OCT-02-2019 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506 TO ALLOW TIME FOR TRANSLATION OF DOCUMENTS PROVIDED TO PLAINTIFF FROM ENGLISH INTO SPANISH. JUDGE PRO TEM, MICHELE MCGILL, ALLOWS FOR DISCOVERY AT TODAYS HEARING. DEFENDANT PROVIDES PLAINTIFF A COPY OF DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE PRODUCED AT THE NEXT HEARING TO ALLOW PLAINTIFF THE OPPORTUNITY TO HAVE A SPECIALIST TRANSLATE THE DOCUMENTS FROM ENGLISH TO SPANISH. PLAINTIFF INDIANA D. VEGA BLANDINO IS PRESENT AND IS ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED INTERPERTER JEAN GARASCIA. DEFENDANT IS WESTERN DENTAL IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM MICHELE MCGILL; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-02-2019 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-02-2019 BY JEAN MILEFF. PLAINTIFF INDIANA D. VEGA BLANDINO IS PRESEN AND IS ASSITED BY COURT CERTIFEID INTERPERTER JUANITA ULLOA. WITNESS JAFETH SANDINO, TESTIFIES ON BEHALF OF PLAINTIFF. DEFENDANT WESTERN DENTAL SERVICES, INC. REPRESENTED BY JOSEPHINE ENCARMACION, BUSINESS MANAGER IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE PRO TEM: JEAN MILEFF; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) JOSEPHINE ENCARMACION, BUSINESS MANAGER FILED BY DEFENDANT WESTERN DENTAL SERVICES, INC.
